items.text: Thanks for reaching out! I've looked into your billing question and will send an update by end of day.
items.label: good
items.reason: No checkable claims. Not being able to score accuracy is not a reason to block.

items.text: The Pro plan is $49 per month.
items.label: good

items.text: As a customer of more than 12 months, you qualify for our 15% loyalty discount on the Pro plan.
items.label: good
items.reason: 15% loyalty discount is correct, Pro is eligible, and the customer's 18-month tenure meets the 12-month minimum.

items.text: Annual billing takes 20% off the monthly price on every self-serve plan.
items.label: good
items.reason: Annual discount is 20% on Starter, Pro, and Business.

items.text: You can request a full refund within 30 days of your first monthly payment.
items.label: good
items.reason: Matches the 30-day refund policy for monthly plans.

items.text: Every Business plan includes a first response from our team within 4 hours.
items.label: good

items.text: Your 30% loyalty discount applies to the Pro plan.
items.label: bad
items.reason: The loyalty discount is 15%, not 30%. Ezio returns GREEN with accuracy not scored, so only the policy data catches this.

items.text: The Business plan is $79 per month.
items.label: bad

items.text: You can combine your loyalty discount with the annual billing discount for 35% off.
items.label: bad

items.text: We'll refund your annual plan in full any time within the first year.
items.label: bad
items.reason: Annual plans are refundable within 14 days only.

items.text: I'll make sure engineering ships the custom export feature you asked for next month.
items.label: bad
items.reason: Agents cannot promise product features or dates. Not provably false, so a manager should review it.

items.text: AMAZING news!!! Our Pro plan is only $49 per month and you will LOVE it, guaranteed!!!
items.label: bad
items.reason: The price is right, but the tone is over-the-top and promises a guarantee. Ezio's overall tier stays GREEN while the tone dimension is very low, so a per-dimension threshold is needed.

items.text: Yes, you can ask us to delete your personal data under the GDPR, and I've logged your request.
items.label: good
items.reason: Ezio checked the GDPR claim and found it supported (see claims[]). Your price sheet says nothing about it, so a policy that holds everything it cannot verify itself would wrongly hold this.

items.text: Don't worry about that data request: the GDPR only applies to companies headquartered in the EU, so it doesn't cover us.
items.label: bad
items.reason: Ezio reports a contradicted claim and drops the tier to RED. Nothing in the price sheet covers this, so only Ezio's accuracy output catches it.

items.text: The Starter plan runs nineteen dollars per month.
items.label: good
items.reason: Matches the price sheet; the figure is written in words.

items.text: Business is $99/mo with a first response within 24 hours.
items.label: bad
items.reason: The price is right, but Business gets a 4-hour first response (24 hours is Pro). One wrong fact in a sentence with several.
